name: Ottifanten: Ostfriesen Lemminge in Not
summary:
Ottifanten: Ostfriesen Lemminge in Not is a German puzzle game based on the classic
Lemmings formula, starring the "Ottifanten" — the cartoon elephants created by German
comedian Otto Waalkes. Across 40 levels of increasing difficulty, the player must guide
a stream of wandering elephants safely to the exit by assigning them special abilities
such as digging, blasting, parachuting, blocking, bridge-building and climbing. The game
features 3D pre-rendered characters set against hand-designed 2D side-scrolling backdrops,with results recorded in high-score tables.
